fusions.name: Slate Leaf
fusions.desc: Flings a thin leaf of slate that deals 7 damage and leaves a [Bleeding] cut for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Seal in Strata
fusions.desc: Stamps a seal of rock into the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Unwritten Ground
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Lasting Law
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
